stories.title: Oregon wins in 84-0 rout despite missing 2 key players on offense
stories.summary: The Ducks were without some key players on offense for their historic 84-0 rout of Portland State as top wide receiver Jeremiah McClellan and starting tight end Jamari Johnson sat out because of injuries.

stories.title: Miami QB Mensah shines again on way to multiple ACC records
stories.summary: It was well into the third quarter, and Darian Mensah was a perfect passer off to a record-setting night while having fifth-ranked Miami's offense humming yet again.

stories.title: Fever's Mitchell surprised by postgame party after setting season scoring record
stories.summary: Kelsey Mitchell scored 33 points against the Tempo to set the WNBA season scoring record. When confetti rained down as she entered the Fever locker room, Mitchell didn't realize the celebration was for her.

stories.title: Brighton rout Arsenal to end Gunners' 100% record
stories.summary: Premier League champions Arsenal lost their 100% record for the season in dramatic fashion as they were routed 3-0 at Brighton and Hove Albion.

stories.title: LSU QB Leavitt, days after doubtful listing, 'ready to go,' Kiffin says
stories.summary: LSU coach Lane Kiffin told ESPN's "College GameDay" that quarterback Sam Leavitt was ready to play against Ole Miss after a "scare" earlier in the week.
